programme.title: The A to Z of TV Gardening
programme.desc: 16/25. A look at some of the BBC's most popular gardening programmes and personalities, presented by Carol Kirkwood. Carol explores subjects that all begin with the letter P.

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: 10/15. Horticulturist Christine Walkden explores gardens and countryside from a hot-air balloon. Christine is in the air above two glorious Gloucestershire gardens.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: The next stop on Anita's road trip is West Mersea in Essex. While the county may be known for engineering and car manufacturing, along its coastline one industry has a much longer history.

programme.title: Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: 2/10. Derek goes island hopping, visiting Caldey off the Pembrokeshire coast, then Anglesey, known for its seabirds, before finishing in south Wales at Barry Island, his childhood home.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: 16/26. The weather in this year's growing season is making gardening a real challenge at Beechgrove, with cold grey skies and periods of high temperature.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt brings a riot of flavour with the help of Bryn Williams, Poppy O'Toole and Gennaro Contaldo. Also, Rick Stein and the Hairy Bikers head out of the studio.

programme.title: A Man for All Seasons
programme.desc: Multi-award winning historical drama about Sir Thomas More's refusal to acknowledge Henry VIII's break with the Roman Catholic Church. Starring Paul Scofield. [1966]

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: World War II drama. A low-ranking officer who resembles General Montgomery is recruited to play his double in an elaborate plan to trick the Nazis. [1958]

programme.title: All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final
programme.desc: Holly Hamilton presents live coverage of Galway v Limerick in the All-Ireland Hurling final at Croke Park.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antiques series. Paul Martin and the Flog It! team are in Greater Manchester, where over 800 people come along to have their items valued at Stockport Town Hall.

programme.title: Fake or Fortune
programme.desc: 1/4. Fiona and Philip unravel the mystery of a suspected Fabergé flower, kept hidden in a shoebox in Liverpool but believed to have belonged to royalty - and worth a small fortune!

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Antiques Roadshow is at Wollaton Hall in Nottingham where treasures include a fire extinguisher cocktail shaker, a pineapple toy monkey and Queen Victoria's undergarments.

programme.title: The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society
programme.desc: An author (Lily James) makes some life-changing friends at a farmer's literary society. [2018]

programme.title: Golf: The Open Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from the final day of the 154th Open as the Champion Golfer of the Year is crowned at Royal Birkdale.

programme.title: Cricket: England v India ODI Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from the third ODI of 2026 between England and India.

programme.title: Margrete: Queen of the North
programme.desc: 1402. Queen Margrete rules Denmark, Norway and Sweden, but a conspiracy is in the making. Contains some violent scenes. [2021]

programme.title: The Tech Billionaire Takeover
programme.desc: A new breed of tech billionaires are building their own countries, replacing democracy as we know it and targeting the global financial system. Matt Shea goes inside their world.

programme.title: Ann Droid
programme.desc: 1/6. Sue's son buys his mother a robot as a present to help her live independently.

programme.title: Animal Park

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: 12/25. Bee and Lauren help Emma downsize a home full of memories after losing her husband. Finding items full of stories in his home library, the family will turn his loss into legacy.

programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: Lightning

programme.title: The Farmers' Country Showdown

programme.title: The Hidden World of Hospitality with Tom Kerridge
programme.desc: 6/8. Tom heads to a remote hotel, an ice cream parlour and his own restaurant to look at inventive methods businesses employ to cope with fluctuating seasonal demand.

programme.title: Wild Brazil
programme.desc: 1/3. Nature series. Three animal families - capuchin monkeys, giant otters and coatis - strive to raise their families in a spectacular yet dangerous environment.

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: New: Secrets In The Dark
programme.desc: Pirate Skeletons and Fairy Coffins: The 1717 wreck of Black Sam Bellamy's pirate ship Whydah yields treasure, skeletons and new insights into the hidden world of piracy. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: Chamber of Secrets: Explore mysterious secrets hidden in tunnels, caves and burial sites, from lost treasures to ancient manuscripts behind walls. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Discovered By Disaster
programme.desc: Fish remains found near an angry Sumatran volcano could suggest a new human migration route and a collapsed kingdom in Turkey gets discovered. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: On August 4, 1990, two hikers near Calvine in Scotland took a photograph of a mysterious, diamond-shaped flying object hovering in the middle of the sky. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: The Pascagoula Abduction recounts a 1973 UFO encounter where Charles Hickson and Calvin Parker claimed aliens abducted them while fishing. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Mysteries From Above
programme.desc: The Planet Unlocked: The Pyramids of Giza could be a map of the stars. First responders bring hope during Hurricane Katrina. An Indonesian volcano erupts in a shade of blue. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly
programme.desc: Henry Cole, Allen Millyard and Guy Willison visit top collector Stuart Imber before preparing to sell their latest finds at the Fairford Steam. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Bulletproof Gator: Series following the Gold family's pawn shop. The Golds clash when a man brings in an angry pet alligator he wants rid of. Will Les make a bad decision? (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Moving Targets: Series following life in the Gold family's pawn shop. Tension mounts when a man blows his top over a mix-up with his gold chain, and an alleged cursed relic scares Ashley.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Trouble Inside: Series following life in a huge Detroit pawn shop. One employee shocks the family by turning violent, and Ashley hits the roof when someone tries to sell her dirty knickers.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Wolverhampton 2: The dealers come across a music box, and some letters from former prime ministers Edward Heath and Harold Macmillan land on Stewart Hogfather's table. (S10, ep 25)

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Join antiques expert and presenter David Dickinson as more collectors try to sell their items to dealers. Will they strike a deal or take a chance at auction instead? (S9, ep 22)

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Bang, Zoom, Pawn on the Moon!: The team check out an autographed Apollo 10 book, a set of Bob Hope's golf clubs and circus sideshow banners.

programme.title: New: Money For Nothing
programme.desc: Upcyclers tackle a road light, retro sofa and worn blankets, racing to transform junk into profit. Can they turn trash into cash in time? (S4, ep 1)

programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: Booby Traps and Safes: A truly enormous auction explodes when rival bidders bet huge sums of money on forfeited international shipping containers. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: Matt Attack: Manic Matt sets out to prove a point in the port of Oakland, gambling early on a container full of liquor before driving up prices. Will his tactics backfire? (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Grin And Barry It: Barry sets out to humiliate Ivy in the next set of auctions. Rene is in for a nasty surprise, while Jarrod and Brandi find themselves surrounded by pigs. (S6, ep 14)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Adventures of Max Profit: Ivy is on the hunt for high-end items in Moreno Valley, while Jarrod reveals to Brandi an alter ego known as Max Profit. (S6, ep 15)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Follow all the drama as the buyers bid on more abandoned storage lockers. What treasures lie inside and can the dealers sell them on for a profit? (S6, ep 16)

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: Pork. Chef James Martin creates a menu inspired by this love of British pork. He starts by creating a succulent brawn terrine and a classic pea and ham soup. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Eggs. James Martin makes eggs the key component to his desserts. He uses the fantastically versatile ingredient to create macaroons, pavlova and the classic baked Alaska. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Italian. James Martin focuses on traditional Italian desserts. He creates a beautiful fruit and nut biscotti served with limoncello, as well as a raspberry and nougat semifreddo. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Mississippi Adventure
programme.desc: Rock And Roll. The duo follow in the footsteps of music legends and sample traditional Tennessean dishes at a classic diner. Next, they visit Elvis Presley's mansion in Memphis. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Nigella Bites
programme.desc: Legacy. Queen of the kitchen, Nigella Lawson, shares the recipes that remind her of her childhood. These are classic, family-favourite meals that are easy to make and very tasty. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Nigella Bites
programme.desc: Slow Cook Weekend. Nigella shares the recipes she loves to enjoy on the weekend. She makes roasted pork, shredded lamb, mint and pomegranate and a scrumptious sticky toffee pudding. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Tommy Banks. Prue welcomes award winning chef, Tommy Banks to her kitchen. She makes two-tone soup and husband John joins her for a goat's curd and tomato galette. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Mystery Guest. With a friend bringing a showbiz mystery guest to dinner, Ina makes a dazzling dinner of smoked salmon blinis and parmesan chicken with lemon vinaigrette. S9, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Breakfast In, Breakfast Out. Ina cooks an omelette and banana bran muffins at home, before having peach raspberry yogurt and bagels with cream cheese and smoked salmon with a friend. S9, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Pastry. With only six bakers left in the tent, the stakes increase as they face the pastry round. The remaining bakers bring the old fashioned suet pudding bang up to date. S4, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Quarter Final. It is the quarter final and now there are just five bakers left, and they face the challenges of unconventional flours and unusual desserts. S4, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Granada. In Granada James samples giant tapas, visits a restaurant with amazing views, and goes to an organic caviar farm. He cooks steak and Moroccan chicken. S1, Ep15

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Murcia. In Murcia James eats exceptional tapas, is shown how to make Caldero and visits an apricot farm. Plus, he cooks cured tuna, steak and roast lobster. S1, Ep16

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. This is the 104th match of the largest World Cup ever, with the tournament concluding a month and six days after it got under way in Mexico. Neutrals will be hoping this contest is as thrilling a spectacle as it was four years ago in Qatar, when France's Kylian Mbappe became the second player after Sir Geoff Hurst to score a hat-trick in a World Cup final. However, it was to no avail, as France were denied a second successive victory when Argentina prevailed 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 draw to lift the trophy for the first time since 1986. Golden Ball-winner Lionel Messi followed in the footsteps of another of the game's great players in the star of their last triumph, Diego Maradona, by finally lifting the trophy, and both Messi and Mbappe have enjoyed fine tournaments again this time around

This is the 104th match of the largest World Cup ever, with the tournament concluding a month and six days after it got under way in Mexico. Neutrals will be hoping this contest is as thrilling a spectacle as it was four years ago in Qatar, when France's Kylian Mbappe became the second player after Sir Geoff Hurst to score a hat-trick in a World Cup final. Golden Ball-winner Lionel Messi followed in the footsteps of another of the game's great players in the star of their last triumph, Diego Maradona, by finally lifting the trophy, and both Messi and Mbappe have enjoyed fine tournaments again this time around

With analysis from Danny Care and Kyle Sinckler, and commentary by Nick Mullins and David Flatman

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef arrives in the riverside town of L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue in south-eastern France, where his culinary hero Keith Floyd once owned a restaurant. Buying produce from its floating market, and a Floyd-style hat, James sets up his mobile kitchen on a bridge overlooking the river, and cooks peaches pain perdu in the sunshine. Heading back in the direction of the town, James samples some truffle-laden dishes at renowned restaurant La Beaugraviere

programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. This is the 104th match of the largest World Cup ever, with the tournament concluding a month and six days after it got under way in Mexico. Neutrals will be hoping this contest is as thrilling a spectacle as it was four years ago in Qatar, when France's Kylian Mbappe became the second player after Sir Geoff Hurst to score a hat-trick in a World Cup final. However, it was to no avail, as France were denied a second successive victory when Argentina prevailed 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 draw to lift the trophy for the first time since 1986. Golden Ball-winner Lionel Messi followed in the footsteps of another of the game's great players in the star of their last triumph, Diego Maradona, by finally lifting the trophy, and both Messi and Mbappe have enjoyed fine tournaments again this time around
